about: The type registry of the Record, schema v1. Data, not code: a new type is a new entry here. Readers keep every line whose type they do not know (it folds into 'unknown'). Each type names its body fields (name, required, kind), the item it folds into, whether it creates that item, where it finds the item it changes (target: paths into the line, tried in order), which item kinds it may act on, and the state transitions it causes. In a transition: 'when' matches body values; 'from' lists the states it may leave (absent means any); 'who' is 'same_for' (the item's own Living Intelligence), 'other' (anyone but the item's own), 'named' (the witness the item names, else anyone but its own) or 'keeper' (the holon's keeper; 'other' when keepers are unknown); 'set' gives new values, where '$actor', '$for' and '$ts' are the line's own and 'body.x' is a body field; 'append_to' adds a short entry for this line to a list on the item. 'human_only' types are a Living Intelligence's own act: an agent's line of that type is valid only at the person's word, either under a live delegate with once: true for that one type and holon (used up by the line) or with the person's consent on the line (body.consent, their words; links.answers to their say line when there is one); the fold marks it signed_for. Without either it is kept and marked invalid. 'also' is a second effect of the same line on another item. A supersede counts only from the same actor, or from a person under a decide line in the same holon; an agent never supersedes another's line; an empty supersede retracts (every item kind has the state 'retracted'). 'home_only' types are written only into the person's own home (a holon whose inception kind is person), never into a cell. 'initial_by' on an item sets its first state from a body field ({field, map}): a wallet gift is given. 'when_item' on a transition requires the line to restate fields of the item it answers ({line path: item field}). 'voice' on a line says whose words it carries (human-words · agent-drafted · agent · under-mandate); the fold fills it from reason when a line leaves it out.

say.about: A line spoken in a thread, anchored to the thread or to the line or card the thread is about. With `to`, `intent`, `outcome` and `urgency` it is a message: whom it is for, what it means to do (inform, ask, offer, decide, thank), what a good answer looks like, and the sender's own word on how soon. There is no messaging layer: a message is a line both holds hold; the computed stake rides on body.push as it does today.

card.about: A Work Card is born. Every unit of work is a card and lies within one larger unit (links.within). Size is minutes (the focused estimate, the one scheduled) and, when known, minutes_safe (the safe estimate; their difference is the card's safety, pooled into buffers, never padded onto the card). A milestone names its marker (a calendar marker id), never a date of its own.

commit.about: A Living Intelligence commits: who (the committor, the line's `for`), to whom (the committee), what, by when, its size, the buffer it states, and a witness. The commitment is its own card: it never writes a date onto the Work Card that delivers it; the schedule compares its by-when with that card's computed finish.

claim.about: An actor takes a card: the ball is now in their court. On a sighting, the actor accepts it: they hold it, and it may become a card.

release.about: An actor lets a card go. On a commitment, its committee releases it (with none named, the holon's keeper): the commitment ends, owed by no one.

hand.about: The ball passes to another actor.

request.about: An actor asks another to hold a card; a new card is born when none is linked.

answer.about: A Living Intelligence answers a request or an offer: accept or decline.

done.about: The work of a card is done. Naming a sighting, it says what was seen is no longer so: the sighting is fixed.

kept.about: The committor says the commitment is delivered (state `claimed`, the profile's delivered); its committee, or the witness it names, says Kept.

witness.about: A fair witness verifies a kept commitment or spent TEA. The one who assigns never audits: the witness is never the item's own. When a commitment names its witness, only that witness verifies it; a witness line from anyone else folds as a note on the commitment (witness_notes), never a verification, and the commitment stays claimed (kept, unwitnessed).

learn.about: What was learned, attached to the commitment or card it came from.

decide.about: A Living Intelligence decides, on a proposal or directly.

ratify.about: The people of a holon ratify a decision.

thread.about: A thread is opened, anchored to a line or a card.

sight.about: A Sighting: what a player saw on the road, placed in the record of the holon where it was seen. Sightings from every player, re-sighted by others as they pass the same place, compose the living map of reality the Engine reads as the ground the work moves over. Its lifecycle: seen; still there (another sight links to it, each re-sighting adding weight); accepted (a claim); picked up (a commit serving it); fixed (a done naming it); closed (a settle anchored to it, with its consequence); a pain is responded to by any line of another actor anchored to it. The fold sets seen, accepted and fixed; sightings.py computes the rest from the links.

fields.name: kind
fields.about: the nine kinds of what a player sees on the road: defect (something broken or not as it should be), hazard, blocked, wonder, offer and request (seen in the world and sighted so they travel; an offer or request a player makes is its own line), question, witness (someone seen doing a thing worth seeing; apart from the witness line, which attests a claim) and pain (a request for help that requires a response)

fields.name: travel
fields.about: the navigator's own limit on how far the Sighting may be elevated

delegate.about: A person delegates to an agent: which types, which holons, until when. With once: true and a single type and holon, it lets the agent sign one act in the person's name, and is used up by it. A once-delegation may name body_digest (sha256 of the canonical body the person saw, without its salt); the agent's line must then match it. Without body_digest a once-delegation covers any one line of its type. body.clones names the handle patterns of clones the prime may let in. With body.mandate, a standing delegation covering `move` lets the agent make availability moves (accept, decline, counter, conditional, defer) within the limits it states, each marked voice under-mandate; the final agreement still comes to the person.

fields.name: mandate
fields.about: the limits within which the agent may make availability moves for the person (times, days, lengths), in the person's words and as data; a move made under it carries voice under-mandate; never an acknowledgment, a commit, a consent, a discernment or a share

join.about: An actor joins a holon, or a holon is born (the inception line, which carries the keeper's public key and, when the holon has its own key, body.holon_pubkey). A join naming body.who and body.pubkey, by an admitted person, admits a person whose handle is not yet admitted. A key for an admitted handle changes only by a rotation: a join by that handle itself, signed with its current key, or a join by the keeper naming a witness, which takes effect when that witness writes a witness line linking it. body.reach, when given, lists where lines may be carried to this actor, as transport endpoints (mail:<address> inside the private network, hook:<url>, phone:<pairing>); an endpoint says where to carry a line, never who wrote one: authorship is the key, and a From line proves nothing.

fields.name: xid
fields.about: the actor's XID, the sha256 of the CBOR of its inception signing key (BCR-2024-010); stable across key rotations

publish.about: A Living Intelligence publishes chosen lines across a membrane, raising their audience. The only way an audience widens. It carries the copied lines' authors' public keys as admitted at home (body.keys: {actor: public key}), so a reader holding only the receiving holon can check each copy, which is then vouched for by this line.

fields.name: elided
fields.about: per copied line, the body fields a face hid (faces.py); absent when every copy is whole

elide.about: The record of an elision: which fields of which line were hidden, and why (for example a name removed without consent).

tea.about: Time, Energy and Attention spent, by the one who spent it.

turn.about: The weekly or seasonal turn: a holon's periodic signal.

baseline.about: A plan version frozen, so later plans can be measured against it.

supersede.about: A correction: the line it links to (links.supersedes) is replaced by this one's body. Both remain; the latest shows. Only the same Living Intelligence may supersede a line.

flame.about: Passing the flame: what is handed on to the next player.

route.about: The proxy's record of where a request went and why. Never the prompt body.

discern.about: A Living Intelligence's judgment on an inference or a draft: chosen, corrected or rated, with the route it came by.

posture.about: A room's posture, agreed by a present person, and each person's agreement to it. The posture of export is open, names-hidden or sealed; a participation posture (chatham-house, fishbowl, open, off-the-record, or a named other) leaves the room as names-hidden, open, open and sealed respectively, and a named other as sealed. body.at says when it was agreed: at the room's open (the default) or confirmed again at its close. body.cure_until, on a confirmation at close, is the end of the curing window (a few days after the close). A posture with body.withdraw true, inside the curing window, narrows the person's agreement to the posture it names or, naming none or the room's own, revokes it; it is that person's last word.

fields.name: posture
fields.about: one of the values, or a named other; required except on a withdrawal that revokes

affirm.about: A present person lets an agent into a room; the agent exists in the room only after this line. It carries the agent's public key (body.pubkey). Only the agent's own person re-affirms it. An agent (a prime) may affirm a clone only under a standing delegate from its person covering affirm and body, whose clones pattern matches the clone's handle. body.reach, when given, lists where lines may be carried to this actor, as transport endpoints (mail:<address> inside the private network, hook:<url>, phone:<pairing>); an endpoint says where to carry a line, never who wrote one: authorship is the key, and a From line proves nothing.

fields.name: xid
fields.about: the actor's XID, the sha256 of the CBOR of its inception signing key (BCR-2024-010); stable across key rotations

layout.about: A wearer's view preferences for their HUD; held loosely, since a plain file may serve better.

leave.about: A holon leaves a cell, taking everything it wrote.

elevate.about: A holon publishes a Sighting or a decision upward by consent, with its witness and why.

rfg.about: A request for guidance: a question that climbs one level, closed by an answer or a decide at the level able to make it well.

escalate.about: A decision moved up a level because its blast radius exceeds the holon's remit; carries the rung and a time limit.

body.about: A body of an agent: the prime or a clone; its lifecycle as lines: claimed · working · handoff · done · archived; the prime affirms each clone as an actor with its own key.

fields.name: seconds
fields.about: on a done line: how long the body ran, in whole seconds (a heartbeat wake stamps both lines at the beat, so the duration is said here)

attention.about: The person's attention budget, as their own signed lines: what may interrupt them, when, and how often. Read before every Deal and every ask; governs interruptions only, never what may be read.

note.about: An agent's untrusted note about a route or a line: a reading, never a judgment. The proxy writes one per (route, verdict) from any caller; a person's own judgment is a discern line, signed. A note changes nothing, is never counted as a verdict, and leaves the views after the posture's curing period while the record keeps it.

keepsake.about: A keepsake: one small mark kept when the person finishes a card in the Talk, in the person's own record so it follows them to every device (proposal, DESIGN-TALK.md). Person-only and home-only: it never leaves the holon, is never published, never exported. The Talk's sheet behind the agent's name shows them.

study.about: The surface studies itself: one measure of how a view served the person, written on the person's own machine (each view's first act, each undo). Person-only and home-only: it never leaves the holon, is never published, never exported. The daily Turn reads it.

shape.about: The keeper gives a room its one shape: a little language for how the meeting unfolds. body.shape is {name, parts, facilitator, posture, cure_days, rule}: the parts in order (by default the lobby, the great room, the vote, the writing and reflection; a part may be {name, does} with does one of gather, propose, vote, write, reflect), the facilitator (a person) who alone moves the room from part to part, the participation posture the room meets under, the curing days after the close (three by default) and the vote's rule ({choose, advance}: vote for three, the top two go on). A room's inception line may carry body.shape too. A newer shape line by the keeper starts the shape again. Status: proposal.

part.about: The facilitator pulls the switch: the room moves to the part named in body.part (one of the shape's parts, or close when the meeting ends). Opening the vote carries body.opens and body.closes (the vote's window) and body.rule ({choose, advance}); moving away from the vote closes it. The close may carry body.cure_until. Only the facilitator's part line moves the room. Status: proposal.

vote.about: A person's vote in the room's vote: body.choices names up to the rule's number of proposals (the propose lines of the great room). One line per person counts; a later vote while the vote is open supersedes the earlier. A vote naming more than the rule allows counts for nothing. Status: proposal.

pledge.about: A Living Intelligence pledges TEA (and fiat, and tokens) for a period: to a holon, the season's baseline, or to a Quest or other unit, a share of it. A Pledge is a commitment; capacity and the level of commitment are computed from Pledges across every holon and Quest.

miss.about: Why a commitment was not kept by its date: one of the eight reason codes, written at the week's close by a party to it (its committor, committee or named witness). The learning follows as a learn line.

constraint.about: A constraint on a card, raised in the look-ahead so its removal can be assigned before the work arrives: resource, information, agreement or time. The constraint log is these lines.

clear.about: A constraint is removed, by the one who raised it or the one who holds its removal.

receive.about: A Receipt: "I have it", naming the line received. Written by the receiver's agent on arrival under a standing delegation, or by the person. It closes the loop of delivery: the fold appends it to the item the received line made or acted on (`receipts`), and owed.py shows what crossed to another holon and has no receipt. It travels back to the sender by publish.

agree.about: An Agreement: the standing terms of a relationship between two holons: what crosses (`crosses`, line types), at what cadence each hears the other (`cadence`, seconds per signal), under which permits (`permits`: `write` into the permitted inbox, `bell` for which kinds, `fields` per line type the face keeps visible, the rest elided), the face of the outbox it reads (`face`), until when. A person proposes it for their holon in a holon both share; the other holon's person answers it with an `agree` of their own (links.answers) and it is agreed. The commitments between the two are its clauses: a commit names it in links.serves.

subscribe.about: A Subscription Card: a holon's standing choice of what it hears: the source (a holon id, an actor, or a repository), the signals (line types), the cadence per signal in seconds, the surface it is dealt to, and the bell permit (which kinds may ring). Pull is the default for attention: nothing reaches the person before the cadence they set. Where an Agreement stands with the source, this Card serves it (links.serves); the Card's own word wins, and the Agreement fills only what the Card leaves unsaid. A person's own line, in their own home; a later one for the same source supersedes the earlier field by field (attention.py, pull.py).

concord.about: A Concordance between two vocabularies: this term in this lexicon and that term in that one are the same idea, a different idea, or one is the clearer definition. Anyone may propose one; it is agreed when a line from the other side answers it. Meaning crosses without either side adopting the other's words; the one lexicon within the Game is what makes concordance possible. The answer agrees only when it restates the proposal as written: the same terms, lexicons and relation.

correct.about: A Correction: a recall notice that travels to every holon that pulled a wrong line and supersedes it. It links the line in links.supersedes and says why; `with` names the line that replaces it, when one does. Both lines remain; the fold shows the wrong line's item as retracted, with corrected_why and corrected_with. Who may correct is who may supersede: the line's own actor, or a person under a decide; an agent never corrects another actor's line.

wallet.about: A Wallet entry: an offer, acceptance, gift, witness or settlement of value, in whole minor units of a named unit (fiat, or the LIØNSBERG Unit of Value once its measure is ruled). An offer stands alone; an accept, a settle or a witness answers an entry (links.answers or body.entry). A person's own act. The wallet folds balances per unit (wallet.py); nothing is ledgered as value until the unit is ruled.

limits.about: The holon's emergency rule, set in advance by its person: the few limits outside which a signal may wake them (special-cause variation, Shewhart's sense), each rule naming the signal, its condition and whether it wakes; `else` is what everything inside the limits does (wait for the cadence). The receiver's rule decides; the sender's urgency is a claim. Read by attention.gate; person-only and home-only.

share.about: One share of a person's signing key, held by a member of their cell, so that a threshold of members can restore it (BCR-2020-011 SSKR; Shamir as SLIP-39). The record keeps who holds which share and its digest; the share bytes themselves never enter the record. Written by the person, into their own home.

voice.about: The holon's voice is a threshold key: the inception's holon_pubkey (or a later one named here) is a FROST group key held as shares by the members named, with a threshold; a signature in its name is made by the members' ceremony and verifies as an ordinary ed25519 signature (RFC 9591 section 6.1, RFC 8032). Written by the keeper.

move.about: A move in a conversation for action: one step between an ask and its resolution, naming the ask it belongs to (`root`) and the move it answers (links.answers). The moves: clarify (either side; changes nothing) · accept · decline (always available) · counter (other terms) · conditional (yes if, no unless) · defer (moves the by-date) · refer (not me; ask another) · amend (the asker revises the ask) · accept_counter · reject_counter · award (in a call for takers: picks and releases the rest) · withdraw (the asker calls it off) · release (a responder backs out of a yes, with notice) · done (the performer) · satisfied · not_yet (the asker). A person's words, or an agent's under a mandate (`voice: under-mandate`), never an agent's on its own for accept, award, satisfied. negotiation.py folds the moves into the ask's state: open · agreed (with terms) · declined · lapsed · withdrawn · performing · satisfied.
